description: Get the authenticated user (the owner of the token in use) as a Vimeo user object.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the authenticated user object (uri, name, link, location, bio, account, created_time, websites, metadata); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List the authenticated user's videos in Vimeo's paged envelope, sorted by created_time descending.

per_page.description: Optional number of items per page (default 25).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paged envelope (total, page, per_page, paging, data) whose data is a list of video objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single video by its id.

video_id.description: The unique id of the video.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the video object (uri, name, description, link, duration, width, height, privacy, status, stats, metadata, user); on failure (video not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single user by their id.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the user object (uri, name, link, location, bio, account, created_time, websites, metadata); on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: List a given user's videos in Vimeo's paged envelope, sorted by created_time descending.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user whose videos to list.

per_page.description: Optional number of items per page (default 25).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paged envelope (total, page, per_page, paging, data) whose data is a list of video objects; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.
